doctrine: Executable tasks from official product surfaces, not slogans. No BETTER_THAN_* scores. No frontier quality claim. SmolLM2-135M Q4_K_M 512-ctx is Nano fallback only.
research_method: Official help centers, product docs, and vendor blogs refreshed 2026-08-13 for AI-USER-READY-002 (ChatGPT Deep Research + Scheduled Tasks, Gemini Deep Research, Gemini Notebook/NotebookLM, Khanmigo, Copilot cloud agent). Third-party roundups used only as pointers; capability classes below are grounded in vendor pages.

capability_classes.executable_task: Follow multi-turn natural-language instructions and keep in-thread context.
Browse the live web and attach citation footnotes to claims when browsing is active.

Plan-gated multi-step research agent: review/edit a research plan, then search/read many sources (web, uploads, connected apps read-only) and return a documented cited report. Distinct from a single web search.
Create one-off or recurring scheduled tasks from a Scheduled page (reminders, recurring work, monitoring for meaningful updates). Plan-gated; not Codex.
Group chats, uploaded files, and custom instructions into a workspace with project-scoped memory.
Save, show, edit, or delete remembered facts used to personalize later chats; user can disable memory.
capability_classes.note: Official help: memory is not currently available in custom GPTs.

capability_classes.executable_task: Open a side workspace to co-write or edit documents/code with inline markup.
Configure a named assistant with instructions, knowledge files, and selected tools/API actions.
Upload PDFs, spreadsheets, docs, or images into a project or chat for grounded answers.
Paid plans may run agent mode that takes multi-step tool actions (plan-dependent).

capability_classes.executable_task: Create an isolated workspace with chat history, uploaded knowledge, and project instructions; paid plans RAG-scale knowledge ~10x.
Emit a standalone editable artifact (doc, code, HTML, SVG, React) in a side window; version, download, targeted edit.
Ground responses in source documents with sentence-level citations.
Store and retrieve information across conversations (account memory and/or /memory files).
Take screenshots and issue mouse/keyboard commands against a desktop (API computer-use tool; beta).
Search the web and attach source attribution to answers.
Execute code and create files; artifacts now require this capability setting.
Connect artifacts/sessions to MCP servers; user must approve tool access.

Turn a prompt into a multi-point research plan the user can refine, autonomously search/browse many websites (and optionally Gmail/Drive/Chat), reason iteratively, and produce a multi-page cited report.
Turn a prompt or research report into a webpage, infographic, quiz, app/game prototype, or audio overview in Canvas.
Create a custom Gem with standing instructions and optional linked notebooks/knowledge.
Upload files into chat or Deep Research (large context on paid plans, up to ~1M tokens advertised).
Answer questions using only uploaded sources (Docs, Slides, PDF, URL, YouTube, audio) with citations back to those sources.
Generate an Audio Overview from notebook sources.
Paid/rolling-out: execute code in a secure cloud computer grounded in notebook sources.
Keep uploaded sources private unless the notebook is shared; vendor states sources are not used for model training.
Guide a learner with questions and hints without giving the direct answer; stay on the current Khan Academy problem.
See the specific practice problem the student is on and discuss that item (not a generic chatbot).
Give guided writing prompts and real-time coding feedback without dumping a finished solution.
Draft lesson plans, rubrics, and progress notes for educators (separate teacher surface).
Answer a query with inline numbered citations that link to live source URLs.
Plan, run dozens of searches, read many sources, and synthesize a comprehensive cited report (typically minutes).
Keep long-running work in a Project with files, instructions, project-scoped memory, and connectors.
Turn research into a report, PDF, deck, spreadsheet, or dashboard inside Computer.

capability_classes.executable_task: Propose next-token / next-hunk code completions in the editor from local file context.
Answer coding questions in-IDE without autonomously editing the workspace.
Produce a structured implementation plan for review before edits.
Autonomously edit files, run terminal commands, and iterate on errors until the task completes (user can review).

Research a repository, create a plan, make code changes on a branch in a GitHub Actions environment, run tests/linters, and open a pull request when ready. Distinct from IDE agent mode. Human review still required before merge.
Run AI code review on a pull request and optionally apply suggested fixes.
